item.title: BDD Quality Lead / Quality Architecture Lead
item.description:
Primary Responsibilities 

-Define and implement a testing strategy aligned with the client's quality and BDD principles. 

-Coach delivery teams, Business Owners, and Product Owners on BDD practices. 

-Drive adoption of Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD), including supporting methodologies and tooling. 

-Improve acceptance criteria quality and overall story readiness. 

-Align business requirements, scenarios, acceptance criteria, and tests. 

-Define an evidence model to support Earn/Burn reporting and delivery measurement.

 

 

We offer:

- Attractive financial package

- Paid vacation, holidays and sick leaves

- Challenging projects

- Professional & career growth

- Great atmosphere in a friendly small team

- Flexible working hours

item.title: Middle Automation QA Engineer with AI
item.description:
Привіт!

 

Ми - performance marketing компанія українського походження 🇺🇦 
Створили всі умови для професійного розвитку: інфраструктуру, ресурси та підтримку. Тому, з ким не працюй, з нами крутіше 😎

 

Зараз шукаємо спеціаліста, який допоможе команді автоматизувати технічні процеси, тестувати мобільні застосунки та створювати рішення, які роблять роботу команди швидшою й ефективнішою.

 

⚡ Що буде у твоїй зоні відповідальності:

AI та автоматизація

  • Створення AI-агентів, скілів та іншої AI-інфраструктури для команди.
  • Розробка автоматизацій, які підвищують ефективність робочих процесів.
  • Створення автоматизованих тестів для мобільних застосунків.
  • Розробка технічних рішень для закупки трафіку: лендинги, Telegram-боти, інтеграції та інші інструменти.

  • Аналіз поточних технічних рішень та пошук способів їх удосконалення.

     

Тестування

  • Ручне тестування мобільних застосунків Android / iOS: frontend, backend, трекери, офери тощо.
  • Тестування нових автоматизацій та їхня подальша адаптація.
  • Робота з логами пристроїв та застосунків.
  • Тестування Desktop-застосунків та Web-сервісів.
  • Пошук, аналіз та контроль дефектів.

 

Аналітика та якість

  • Налаштування та перевірка систем аналітики: AppsFlyer, Google Analytics, Firebase, Google Tag Manager та інших.
  • Визначення критичності багів та прийняття рішень щодо їхнього виправлення.
  • Контроль якості автоматизацій та технічних рішень.
  • Покращення процесів тестування, щоб мінімізувати потрапляння дефектів у production.

 

💥 Що для нас важливо:

  • Досвід автоматизації процесів та створення власних технічних рішень.
  • Практичний досвід створення AI-агентів / AI-скілів.
  • Досвід ручного тестування мобільних застосунків Android та/або iOS і розуміння специфіки платформ.
  • Досвід створення автоматизованих тестів.
  • Розуміння клієнт-серверної архітектури та REST API.
  • Практичний досвід роботи з Xcode, Android Studio, Postman.
  • Досвід роботи з емуляторами та симуляторами.
  • Досвід розробки лендингів, Telegram-ботів та інших технічних рішень.
  • Досвід налаштування та перевірки систем аналітики.
  • Впевнена робота з Google Firebase.
  • Уміння працювати в режимі Debug.
  • Системність, уважність до деталей та бажання не просто знаходити проблеми, а знаходити спосіб їх автоматизувати або попередити.

 

Якщо тобі цікаво поєднувати QA, автоматизацію, AI та технічні задачі, а не просто перевіряти готовий функціонал — давай знайомитись 🚀

item.title: Senior QA
item.description:
We’re working in one of the most important sectors of the global economy: maritime shipping.

Nearly everyone is affected by goods moving across the seas, whether that’s energy, raw materials, food, or wind turbines. Yet much of the industry is still hampered by manual processes, paperwork, and bureaucracy.

We’re a seven-year-old startup with strong revenue growth, several Fortune 100 customers, and strong VC backing. We’re building software that makes maritime shipping easier, more transparent, and more cost-effective — and we’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer to help us build quality into the way we develop and deliver it.

This is not a role focused only on testing completed tickets. You’ll work throughout the development lifecycle: understanding risk, shaping validation strategies, improving quality practices, owning release confidence, and helping prevent defects before they reach customers.

Responsibilities

- Work closely with developers, product managers, designers, customers, and other stakeholders to understand business behaviour, technical risk, and expected outcomes.
- Define pragmatic test strategies based on risk and determine what needs to be validated before a change is safe to release.
- Design, develop, and maintain automated testing using Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript, including UI, API, and hybrid workflows where appropriate.
- Perform exploratory and investigative testing of complex product behaviour, integrations, edge cases, and customer-specific configurations.
- Investigate and triage defects, understand root causes and affected areas, assess risk, and verify fixes through to production.
- Help improve both QA and QC practices across the engineering organisation, including how requirements are challenged, risks are identified, and quality is measured.
- Help design and evolve CI/CD gating strategies so that meaningful quality checks protect the delivery pipeline and prevent unsafe changes from progressing.
- Use AI as part of the QA workflow and help develop safe, repeatable AI-assisted QA pipelines for analysis, investigation, test generation, coverage assessment, and validation, with appropriate safeguards.
- Take ownership of release quality and release readiness, bringing together test results, known risks, unresolved defects, dependencies, and production considerations to support clear go/no-go decisions.
- Support releases through deployment and production verification, and help improve the release process based on what we learn from incidents, defects, and customer feedback.

Requirements

- Minimum 5 years of experience in software testing / quality engineering, including experience with automated testing in a B2B SaaS product.
- Experience with Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript, or equivalent experience with another modern automation framework and the ability to work effectively with Playwright.
- Experience testing beyond the black-box level and investigating behaviour across the product and supporting systems.
- Strong understanding of risk-based testing and risk management — the ability to identify where failures matter most, prioritise validation accordingly, and communicate residual risk clearly.
- Experience with CI/CD, Git, pull-request workflows, and quality gates.
- Practical experience using AI within QA or software engineering workflows, with an understanding of how AI-generated output should be validated and constrained.
- Experience taking ownership of or contributing significantly to release readiness and production validation.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, explaining risk, asking difficult questions, and communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to reason about complex systems rather than simply execute predefined test cases.
- Intellectual curiosity and an interest in understanding maritime shipping and the business problems our customers are trying to solve.
- A desire to work closely with customers, end users, developers, designers, product managers, and other stakeholders rather than treating QA as a separate downstream function

item.title: QA Automation Engineer
item.description:
Phoenix Games is an innovative technology company building next-generation iGaming and Web3 products for a global audience. We combine modern engineering, AI, blockchain, and cloud technologies to create scalable and reliable digital gaming experiences.

We're looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help us build a strong automated testing culture and ensure the quality, stability, and reliability of our products.

 

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for web applications.
  • Create reliable end-to-end, integration, regression, and smoke tests.
  • Automate critical user journeys and business scenarios.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of our QA automation framework.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze test results, investigate failures, and identify root causes.
  • Collaborate closely with Developers, QA Engineers, Product Managers, and DevOps.
  • Participate in test planning and contribute to QA strategy.
  • Identify potential quality risks and help prevent issues before production.
  • Improve test coverage, stability, and execution speed.
  • Maintain clear and structured test documentation.

 

Requirements

  • 3+ years of commercial experience in QA Automation.
  • Strong experience with at least one modern automation framework.
  • Good programming skills in TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Python, or another relevant language.
  • Experience building and maintaining automated testing frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies and software testing processes.
  • Experience with API testing.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Understanding of web applications, HTTP, REST APIs, and browser technologies.
  • Experience debugging automated test failures.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Upper-Intermediate English or higher.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Playwright.
  • Experience with Selenium, Cypress, WebdriverIO, or similar tools.
  • Experience with API automation.
  • Experience with SQL and databases.
  • Experience with Docker.
  • Experience testing high-load applications.
  • Experience in iGaming, Gaming, FinTech, or SaaS.
  • Familiarity with Web3 or blockchain products.
  • Experience with performance or security testing.
  • Experience working in distributed international teams.

 

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work from anywhere in Europe.
  • Long-term B2B cooperation.
  • Competitive salary paid in EUR or USD.
  • Annual salary reviews.
  • Performance-based bonus program.
  • Annual company bonus.
  • 25 paid vacation days.
  • Paid sick leave.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Home office budget.
  • Laptop or equipment allowance.
  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications, conferences, and books.
  • English language lessons.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Sports and wellness compensation.
  • Team-building activities and international company retreats.
  • Opportunity to work with AI, Web3, blockchain, and modern cloud technologies.
  • Clear career growth opportunities within a fast-growing international product company.

Why Join Phoenix Games?

At Phoenix Games, automation is an important part of our engineering culture. You'll have the opportunity to improve QA processes, influence our automation strategy, and work closely with experienced engineers to deliver reliable products to a global audience.

If you're passionate about test automation and enjoy solving complex quality challenges, we'd love to hear from you.
